name: Router Console
description: A sidebar panel for your Minih Router: it asks the configured control plane who the saved key belongs to and opens the admin console or the key usage page that matches.
author: minih

en.name: Router Console
en.description: A sidebar panel for your Minih Router: it asks the configured control plane who the saved key belongs to and opens the admin console or the key usage page that matches.
en.safetyNotes: Keeps the control-plane address and credential you type in this plugin's own settings file, in plain text on this machine, and sends them only to that address when it reads /api/auth/session. It never writes to the Router and never touches an AccessKey configured elsewhere in the app.

zh-CN.name: Router 控制台
zh-CN.description: 侧边栏里的 Minih Router 面板：向配置的控制面询问这枚凭据属于谁，并打开对应的管理后台或 key 用量页。
zh-CN.safetyNotes: 你在设置里填写的控制面地址与凭据会以明文保存在本机这个插件自己的设置文件里；只有读取 /api/auth/session 时才会发往该地址。插件不改动 Router 数据，也不读取应用其它位置配置的 AccessKey。

safetyNotes: Keeps the control-plane address and credential you type in this plugin's own settings file, in plain text on this machine, and sends them only to that address when it reads /api/auth/session. It never writes to the Router and never touches an AccessKey configured elsewhere in the app.

settings.title: Control-plane address
settings.description: Root of the Minih Router, for example https://router.example.com. Plain http is accepted for a local instance.

settings.title: Credential
settings.description: An AccessKey, or an admin token if you have one. It opens the admin console only when the Router reports that credential as admin; otherwise it opens the key usage page. Stored in plain text in this plugin's settings file on this machine.

settings.title: Open the console as soon as the panel opens
settings.description: Hands the matching page to your browser while the panel stays as the status readout.
